tagline: Bent by hand, lit all night.
one_liner: A two-bender studio hand-forming commissioned neon for bars, venues and late-opening shopfronts.

positioning.who_its_for: Bar, club and late-licence venue owners whose frontage has to pull people in off an unlit street.
positioning.what_problem: LED strip pretending to be neon reads as plastic up close and goes patchy within two winters.
positioning.why_them: Real glass, real gas, bent on our own ribbon burner, and we come back and relight it when it fails.

products.name: Commissioned Frontage Sign
products.description: A sign drawn, bent and pumped to order for one frontage: glass tubing, transformer, mounts and installation on site.
features: Drawing and layout agreed before any glass is bent
Hand-bent tubing, pumped and aged on our own bench
Installed and set running on site

products.name: Relight and Re-Gas Plan
products.description: A twice-yearly visit for signs that burn every night: dim tubes re-gassed, failed electrodes replaced, housings cleaned.
features: Two visits a year, worked out of hours
Dim tubes re-gassed and failed electrodes replaced
Callout inside 48 hours if a sign goes out
not_covered: Glass broken by impact or vandalism

do: Describe the work lit, at night, in the colour it actually burns
Name the gas and the coating that make a colour
dont: Call the work tasteful, understated or restrained
Show a sign switched off, or photographed in daylight
